instructions: Read-only history of the Cleared ledger: sessions, their events, review verdicts and decisions. Secrets, keys and service folders are removed from every answer. Search with search_sessions or search_events, then read one session in order with get_session_timeline. Each answer is one page: pass its next value back to get the following one. A search that reads a great many rows stops and answers partial: true, with the matches it found so far, perhaps none; pass its next value back to go on.
tool_search_sessions: Finds sessions, newest first. A session gives its ticket, project, role, harness, model, status, service, its number of events and how long it ran. A partial answer (partial: true) stopped before the end: pass next back to go on.
tool_search_events: Finds session events, newest first: messages, tool calls and their cleaned results, steps, review verdicts (type cleared.review_verdict), questions and permission answers. A partial answer (partial: true) stopped before the end: pass next back to go on.
tool_get_session_timeline: Reads one session and its events in order, a page at a time.
arg_text_sessions: Words to find in the session's id, ticket, project, role, harness, model, status or service, without regard to case.
arg_text_events: Words to find in the event's cleaned content, without regard to case. A term shaped like a secret is refused.
arg_ticket: Only this ticket, as written in the ledger (LOCAL-7, ENG-42).
arg_role: Only this role: author, reviewer, lead or reader.
arg_session_filter: Only the events of this session id.
arg_type: Only this event type (TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT, TOOL_CALL_RESULT, RUN_ERROR) or this custom event name (cleared.review_verdict, cleared.permission_answered, cleared.question).
arg_from: From this day (2026-10-20) or this moment (2026-10-20T09:00:00Z), included.
arg_to: Up to this day or this moment, included.
arg_limit: Items in the page: {default} if left out, at most {max}.
arg_cursor: The next value of the previous page, to get the one after it.
arg_after_seq: Only the events after this sequence number: the next value of the previous page.
error_limit: limit is a whole number from 1 up; above {max}, {max} are given.
error_cursor: This cursor is not the next value of a page of this tool. Search again without it.
error_term_shape: The search term is shaped like a secret. Secrets are removed from the history, so it cannot be found.
error_after_seq: after_seq is a whole number from 0 up.
error_unknown_argument: {name} is not an argument of this tool.
error_argument_type: {name} has the wrong type: see the tool's schema.
error_read: The ledger could not be read. Try again in a moment.
